NIP-05 proves a live two-sided mapping, not a person's trustworthiness.

A client should compare the latest signed kind 0 nip05 value with the domain's well-known response. The exact name must map to the same 64-character lowercase hex pubkey, and redirects must be ignored.

Follow the pubkey, never the address. If the domain later maps the name to another key, keep the existing follow and stop displaying the stale identifier.
